fields.name: APP_NAME
fields.label: Application name
fields.help: The name shown in your new application.

fields.name: OWNER_EMAIL
fields.label: Owner email
fields.help: Local runs sign this owner in automatically; no email is sent.

fields.name: MFA_KEY
fields.label: Multi-factor sealing key
fields.help: Seals members' authenticator-app secrets. Keep a copy with your archives: a restore without it puts members back at enrollment.

fields.name: PORTAL_KEY
fields.label: Customer-session signing key
fields.help: Signs short-lived customer portal sessions. Installation-held and excluded from archives; a restore needs a new key and newly issued customer sessions.

fields.name: IDENTITY_PROVIDER
fields.label: Identity provider
fields.help: Optional Auth install. Leave empty to use email links.

fields.name: STRIPE_BILLING_SECRET
fields.label: Stripe billing secret
fields.help: Optional. Enables owner-reviewed collection of retained open Stripe invoices. Kept in installation secrets and excluded from archives.
